description: This file defines a custom exception class 'LoanOfficerAssignmentException' used in the loan account module of the Fineract project. It extends an abstract exception class and provides constructors to create exceptions related to loan officer assignment errors.

classes.name: LoanOfficerAssignmentException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating issues with loan officer assignment, such as unassignment or date conflicts.

methods.name: LoanOfficerAssignmentException(Long, Long)
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception when a loan is not assigned to a specific loan officer.

methods.name: LoanOfficerAssignmentException(Long, LocalDate)
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception when the assignment date is before the last assignment.
